title: Grateful Dead Live at KQED Studios on 1970-08-30

ai_review.summary: Very poor recording quality with a sluggish performance; only the Candyman segment stands out.
ai_review.review: All three reviewers agree that this version of the August 30 1970 KQED Studios show suffers from bad audio/video fidelity and a generally slow, unengaging vibe. The first song “Easy Wind” is described as virtually unwatchable, while the later “Candyman” portion is noted as the only redeeming moment. Listeners are urged to seek out alternate versions of this concert.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently low star ratings (0‑2) and uniformly negative comments about both the performance and the recording drive a very low overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers complain of slow playback, psychedelic visual effects that make the first song unwatchable, and generally bad fidelity; they recommend using an alternate IA version instead.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Uneven – the opening “Easy Wind” is criticized as unwatchable, but the show improves after the Candyman segment before falling back to overall sluggishness.
